commissioning guide',wzBBStep0Hdr:'The commissionning process',wzBBStep0Info:' The guide helps to go through all the mandatory tests of the central ventilation system, which is equipped with separated volume flow elements - SMART boxes
Step 1 - the testing of occasional draft or unknown source of the air pressure.
Step 2 - the testing of the correct orientation setting and clearness of the duct system on the side of the supply (M-SUP is running)
Step 3 - the testing of the correct orientation setting and clearness of the duct system on the side of the extract(M-ETA is running)
Step 4 - the testing of the tightness of closed dampers on the supply side of the duct system (M-SUP is running)
Step 5 - the testing of the tightness of closed dampers on the extract side of the duct system (M-SUP is running)

Steps 6 and 7 are available only if the function -Stowaway- is enabled (Parameter 3.1.53).

Step 6 - The setting of the minimal control voltage for the supply fan to support the -Stowaway- function
Step 7 - The setting of the minimal control voltage for the extract fan to support the -Stowaway- function
',wzBBStep1Hdr:'Draft examination - Step 1/',wzBBStep2Hdr:'Test of the orientation setting(SUP) - Step 2/',wzBBStep3Hdr:'Test of the orientation setting(ETA) - Step 3/',wzBBStep4Hdr:'Test of the dampers tightness(SUP) - Step 4/',wzBBStep5Hdr:'Test of the dampers tightness(ETA) - 5/',wzBBStep6Hdr:'Stowaway setting (SUP) - Step 6/',wzBBStep7Hdr:'Stowaway setting (ETA) - Step 7/',wzBBStep8Hdr:'Central ventialation system - Report',wzBBStep1Info:'The Step 1 examinates possible draft or external source of volume flow. All the dampers are opened during the this part of test and both fans of the ventilaiton unit are stopped. During this test, no volume flow shoul be detected by every SMART box in the system in both of the directions; in the supply duct and in the extract duct.',wzBBStep2Info:'The step 2 examines the orientation setting of all the SMART boxes in the system. All the dampers are opened, the Supply fan is controlled to 4V, the extract fan is stopped. A volume flow in the supply duct of every SMART box is expected. If there is measurable volume flow in the extract duct, it might be a result of the building tightness, however, the volume flow in the supply duct must be higher than in the extract duct.',wzBBStep3Info:'The step 3 examines the orientation setting of all the SMART boxes in the system. All the dampers are opened, the Extract fan is controlled to 4V, the supply fan is stopped. A volume flow in the extract duct of every SMART box is expected. If there is measurable volume flow in the supply duct, it might be a result of the building tightness, however, the volume flow in the extract duct must be higher than in the supply duct.',wzBBStep4Info:'Wait until all the dampers are closed. The step 4 examines the tightness of the closed dampers in the supply duct. During the test, the supply fan is controlled to 3V. No volume flow in the duct is expected. If there is a higher volume flow than 5% in any SMART box, it might be caused by inaccurate tightness or wrong position of the damper.',wzBBStep5Info:'Wait until all the dampers are closed. The step 4 examines the tightness of the closed dampers in the extract duct. During the test, the extract fan is controlled to 3V. No volume flow in the duct is expected. If there is a higher volume flow than 5% in any SMART box, it might be caused by inaccurate tightness or wrong position of the damper.',wzBBStep6Info:'All the dampers of SMART boxes in the system is closed and the supply fan is controlled. Set the control voltage of the supply fan in order to achieve required volume flow in the supply duct which belongs to the duct for ventilation of the room, which are not equipped with the SMART box (the stowaway). Once the volume flow gets to the required level, press the button - Record the value. Tha value of the control voltage will be used as a minimum control voltage of the supply fan (parameter 3.1.54).',wzBBStep7Info:'All the dampers of SMART boxes in the system is closed and the extract fan is controlled. Set the control voltage of the extract fan in order to achieve required volume flow in the extract duct which belongs to the duct for ventilation of the room, which are not equipped with the SMART box (the stowaway). Once the volume flow gets to the required level, press the button - Record the value.
